permissions.purpose: Finds the Stripe customer of the person signed in to your product, so the assistant only answers about their own billing.
Shows the signed-in person their plan, status and renewal date.
Cancels, resumes or switches the signed-in person's plan, only when you turn these actions on and they confirm.
Lists the signed-in person's invoices, with links to each one.
Tells the signed-in person which card their subscription is billed to.
Shows plan names instead of IDs.
Lists your prices, so you can choose which plans the assistant may switch people to.
Creates a billing portal link where the signed-in person can update their card or download invoices.
Shows which Stripe account is connected in the Oriel dashboard.
